title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V60
paragraphs: Create and manage your lighting, power, control, truck pack and label paperwork in one browser workspace.
V60 adds an account page for projects, templates and profile details. Public account registration is coming soon; you can continue using the app on this device.
For page-specific guidance, select the question mark above Menu in the sidebar.
Check your paperwork before use and download regular project backups.
